Ava: Quick design pass on Trace viewer drilldown — wanted to align on the Export action, correlation ID UX, and a11y nits. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/trace-drill.png :eyes: Carlos: Looking now. Are we adding Export to the top-right action menu or inline by each span? Ava: Proposal: keep top-right global export (applies to whole trace) + inline kebab for span-level export (single span). Global export should be primary in header, not buried in overflow. Maya: Agree on two levels. But header export needs more discoverability. Current icon is small and no text — hard for screen readers. Priya: Accessibility notes: - export button needs aria-label and visible focus state - color of header CTA (#5A67D8) vs background contrast fails 3:1 on small text - correlation id copy needs live region announcement Carlos: For copy we can add a tiny copy icon next to corr-id. When clicked: `Copied correlation ID: 1234-abc` toast. We should also support keyboard focus on the corr-id element. Ava: On copy toast — prefer inline ephemeral tooltip vs global toast? Tooltip is closer to context but can be missed by AT. Priya: Use both: visible tooltip + ARIA live region. Example aria: `aria-live="polite"` and tooltip text "Correlation ID copied". Maya: Stack trace display — current layout truncates lines and hides file paths. Suggest collapsible raw view that preserves monospace and allows `Copy all`. Carlos: For raw view, we can reuse our existing code block component with `Copy` button. Example markup: ``` 
  Error: something went wrong
  at /app/server/handler.js:45:12
``` Ava: Copy button copy-all should be keyboard reachable and announced. Also consider a small "open in logs" link that uses correlation ID to deep-link to Logs. Priya: Contrast: the red error badge (#E53E3E) on white is fine, but muted badges use #718096 which is low contrast. Increase weight or use bold text. Maya: Minor copy tweak: header "Trace details" -> "Trace details & exports"? Maybe too long. Alternative: keep 'Trace details' and add small label under export button: "Export trace". Carlos: One UI tradeoff: adding text to the header increases horizontal density on mobile. Maybe hide text under 720px and show icon+aria-label. Ava: Good call. So final asks: 1) Header export icon -> add visible label on desktop, icon-only on narrow screens, aria-label for all 2) Span-level kebab -> include 'Export span' and 'Copy correlation id' 3) Implement copy live-region + tooltip 4) Stack trace raw view with Copy all 5) Contrast adjustments for muted badges Priya: I'll add a short checklist with WCAG references and do a small color token PR. Carlos: I'll prototype header changes and paste a quick Figma link later. DevBot: Deployment pipeline check — design branch created: feature/trace-export-ux Ava: Thanks all — tagging @here for any missed UX edge cases :sparkles:
